svg.title: Code components of the Patient Journey Matcher
svg.desc: UML package diagram. Crawler (Python): cli uses runner, store and sources; runner uses sources and links; links uses sources; store uses the SQL schema in db/init. Matcher (TypeScript) in three layers. Programs: mcp-server, indexer depend on approaches, transcriber only on the libraries; evaluation uses the saved results of mcp-server; the programs layer depends on the libraries layer. Matching: approaches (createApproaches, selectApproaches) uses the interface Approach of core and instantiates the approaches keyword, graph and ai_summary in algorithms, which implement the interface Approach of core; the matching layer depends on the libraries layer. Libraries: core (interfaces Approach, Indexer and Matcher, data types JourneyState and Hit, reciprocalRankFusion), db (DocumentStore, createPool, indexChangedDocuments; uses the SQL schema in db/init) and download (Downloader, extractText, createTranscriber).
